description: The dashboard window draws its own titlebar (tauri.conf.json sets decorations: false for it, see ui/dashboard/index.html's #panel-header) instead of relying on macOS's native close/minimize/zoom — these are the core window-plugin permissions its custom traffic-light buttons and drag handle need. No other window (pill, recovery) uses these; both keep either native decorations or no user-facing window chrome at all.
